notes.title: Update (v1.0.0.4)
notes.content:
Here is the list of changes brought by the new version 1.0.0.4 : 
[list]
[*] Resolved a solo bug that was displaying the wrong defeat condition to the player.
[*] Minor text corrections
[*] Adding a timer to display the waiting time when searching for a multiplayer game
[*] Adding a red button to launch the bomb
[/list]
